options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:

options.doc_fr:

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: Goal
options.doc:
Your Victory Condition.

Asylum Brain Tank: Climb the Asylum and defeat the Coach Oleander Brain Tank.

Brain Hunt: Find the required amount of Camper Brains and re-brain them in Ford's Sanctuary.

Asylum Brain Tank and Brain Hunt: Find the required amount of Camper Brains, AND defeat the Coach Oleander Brain Tank.

choices.label: Asylum Brain Tank And Brain Hunt

options.name: Brains Required
options.doc:
Number of Brains required to collect to Win, or open final door to Meat Circus Final Bosses.

If Goal is not Brain Hunt, or Asylum Brain Tank and Brain Hunt, this does nothing.

options.name: Require Meat Circus
options.doc: Require finishing Meat Circus Final Bosses in addition to your goal.

options.name: Rank Sanity
options.doc: Add Rank Rewards to EVERY Rank Up, instead of the traditional Five Ranks Up.
options.doc_fr: Ajouter des récompenses de classement à TOUS les classements, au lieu des cinq classements traditionnels.

options.name: Figment Percentage Maximum
options.doc:
Controls the maximum percentage of figments needed from each mind that will send checks.

One check is sent for every 20 percent of figments found in each mind, up to the maximum set here.

If set to 0, no figment collecting is required.
options.doc_fr:
Contrôle le pourcentage maximal de figments nécessaires de chaque esprit qui enverra des vérifications.

Un chèque est envoyé pour chaque 20 pour cent des figments trouvés dans chaque esprit, jusqu'au maximum fixé ici.

Si la valeur est fixée à 0, il n'est pas nécessaire de collecter des figments.

options.name: Deep Arrowhead Shuffle
options.doc:
Add Deep Arrowhead checks and shuffle the Dowsing Rod and extra Arrowhead Bundles into the item pool.

Deep Arrowhead locations must be dug up from the ground using the Dowsing Rod and will set a shorter 10-minute
(unpaused in-game time) respawn time after being dug up for the first time. Digging up a Deep Arrowhead again, after
waiting for it to respawn, will award arrowheads like normal and set the normal 30-minute respawn time.

The Deep Arrowheads found under the Lake are not affected by this option.
options.doc_fr:
Ajouter les contrôles de Deep Arrowhead et mélanger le Dowsing Rod et les blocs supplémentaires Arrowhead dans la piscine d'articles.

Les emplacements de Deep Arrowhead doivent être creusés à partir du sol à l'aide de la Dowsing Rod et fixeront une période de réapparition plus courte de 10 minutes (temps de jeu sans pause) après avoir été creusé pour la première fois. Après avoir attendu qu'il soit remis à l'eau, on lui attribuera des têtes de flèche comme la normale et on fixera le temps normal de remise à l'eau de 30 minutes.

Cette option n'a pas d'incidence sur les fléchettes profondes trouvées sous le lac.

options.name: Mental Cobweb Shuffle
options.doc:
Add Mental Cobweb checks and shuffle an extra PSI Card into the item pool for each Mental Cobweb.

Mental Cobweb locations must be collected using the Cobweb Duster. Collecting a Mental Cobweb will not add it to
Raz's inventory, so the loom in Ford's Sanctuary will have no use.
options.doc_fr:
Ajouter Mental Cobweb vérifie et mélanger une carte PSI supplémentaire dans la piscine d'articles pour chaque Mental Cobweb.

Les emplacements de Cobweb mentale doivent être recueillis à l'aide du Duster Cobweb. Collecter un Cobweb Mental ne l'ajoutera pas à l'inventaire de Raz, donc le métier dans le Sanctuaire de Ford n'aura aucune utilité.

options.name: Scavenger Hunt Rewards
options.doc:
Add Scavenger Hunt Completion Rewards as Locations.

Half: Adds a location for redeeming 8 scavenger hunt items with Ford in the camp.

All: Adds two locations for redeeming 8 and 16 scavenger hunt items with Ford in the camp.
options.doc_fr:
Ajouter les récompenses d'achèvement de chasse au trésor comme lieux.

Half: Ajoute un emplacement pour racheter 8 objets de chasse au trésor avec Ford dans le camp.

All: Ajoute deux emplacements pour racheter 8 et 16 objets de chasse au trésor avec Ford dans le camp.

options.name: Hint Unclaimed Baggage
options.doc:
When interacting with Baggage that you don't have a matching tag for yet, automatically creates a hint for 
the location in the client.

options.name: Progressive Baggage
options.doc:
Turns Emotional Baggage into Progressive Locations.

Each time you redeem a Baggage Tag with it's matching Baggage, you'll earn the next check for that type.

If toggled off, each Baggage redeemed will reward a Rank Up instead.

options.name: Maximum Progressive Baggage
options.doc:
Maximum amount of each type of Baggage that will give checks.

Progressive Baggage collected beyond the maximum will reward a Rank Up instead.

Only works if Progressive Baggage is Enabled and value is greater than 0.

options.name: Vault Hints
options.doc: When receiving a Memory Vault, hint a random location in your AP world that hasn't been collected yet.

options.name: Vaults in Item Pool
options.doc: How many Memory Vaults are added to the item pool.
options.doc_fr: Combien de failles mémoire sont ajoutées au pool d'articles.

options.name: Easy Flight Mode
options.doc:
Replicate the Levitation Flight Glitch by simply holding down float in the air. No more button mashing.
WARNING: Makes getting locations out of logic VERY easy.

options.name: Easy Milla Race
options.doc: Makes collecting figments and winning the race in Milla's Mind easier by removing everyone else from the race.

options.name: Better Dowsing Rod
options.doc: Makes the Dowsing Rod gauge fill faster to collect Deep Arrowheads easier.

options.name: Enemy Damage Multiplier
options.doc:
Adjust how much damage Raz takes from enemies for an additional challenge.
If set to 0, Raz will take no damage from enemies, but will still flinch.
options.doc_fr:
Ajustez la quantité de dégâts que Raz prend aux ennemis pour un défi supplémentaire.
S'il est réglé à 0, Raz ne prendra aucun dommage de la part des ennemis, mais continuera à fléchir.

options.name: Instant Death Mode
options.doc: Take any amount of damage, die instantly. Has priority over Enemy Damage Multiplier.
